radar_watch.eventDescription: One topic with limited convergence between research and patents. Includes paper and patent counts, top venues, and top assignees.

radar_emerging.eventDescription: One topic where academic research is accelerating but patent activity is still thin. An early lead before the IP race. Includes research momentum, top papers, and the few patents on file.

radar_commercializing.eventDescription: One topic with strong research momentum and active patent filing at the same time. Commercialization underway. Includes top papers, top assignees, recent filings, and the full convergence score. The first commercializing topic per run is free so you can validate output.
